features.name: External Storage for Document Attachments
features.description: Feature that allows offloading document attachments from the Business Central database to external storage such as blob storage, file share, or SharePoint. Files are automatically migrated based on configured policies.
caveats: Users are using this feature at their own risk
Once files are offloaded to external storage, Business Central is not responsible for backups
If files are deleted on external storage, they will not be available in Business Central
Root folder must be configured for the storage to work

features.name: Scheduled Upload with Job Queue
features.description: Automated job queue that runs each night at 1:00 a.m. by default to automatically offload all document attachments from the database to external storage.
caveats: Must be explicitly enabled in additional scenario setup

features.name: Immediate Delete After Upload Policy
features.description: Policy option to immediately delete files from Business Central after they have been uploaded to external storage. When enabled, the delayed delete option becomes non-editable.
caveats: Once enabled, delayed delete becomes non-editable

features.name: Delayed Delete with Date Formula
features.description: Policy option that keeps files in Business Central for a specified period using a date formula before automatic deletion. Default example shown is 7 days.
caveats: Becomes non-editable if immediate delete is enabled

features.name: Delete External Files on Attachment Deletion
features.description: Optional policy that controls whether external files are deleted when attachments are removed from Business Central. When disabled, files remain on external storage even after deletion in Business Central.
caveats: When disabled, files remain on external storage after Business Central deletion

features.name: Storage Sync Feature
features.description: Feature that allows offloading of existing document attachments already stored in the Business Central database to external storage.

features.name: Restore Attachments from External Storage
features.description: Feature allowing users to retrieve and restore document attachments from external storage back to the Business Central database.
